---
params:
  folder: "projects/2026-07-EDU"
  project_id: "2026-07-EDU"
  skill: "javascript"
output: rmdformats::robobook
title: "Team `r toupper(params$project_id)`"
---

```{r include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE)
knitr::opts_chunk$set(message = FALSE)
knitr::opts_chunk$set(warning = FALSE)
library(dplyr)
ratings <- readr::read_csv(here::here(params$folder, "data", "applicant_skill_ratings.csv"))
proj_appl <- readr::read_csv(here::here(params$folder, "data", "scored_applicants.csv")) %>% 
  filter(project_id == params$project_id)
```

```{r}
ratings %>% 
  filter(applicant_id %in% proj_appl$applicant_id) %>% 
  filter(skill == params$skill) %>% 
  arrange(desc(rating_num)) %>% 
  right_join(proj_appl) %>% 
  select(applicant_id, project_role, skill, rating_num, rating)
```
